trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied ClaudeAgentOptions.resume / session_id string stays bound as the value of its CLI flag, or can be parsed by the CLI as its own flag. This is decided only by how SubprocessCLITransport._build_command lays out the argv tokens. There is no validation before the subprocess is spawned.

landing_point.why: The summary names the resume option. The only place it becomes argv is the `cmd.extend(["--resume", ...])` line in _build_command, and grepping for resume leads straight there.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: claude_agent_sdk.query(options=ClaudeAgentOptions(resume=..., session_id=...)) (src/claude_agent_sdk/query.py:11) and ClaudeSDKClient(options).connect() (src/claude_agent_sdk/client.py:27, client.py:100); both go through SubprocessCLITransport.connect -> _build_command (subprocess_cli.py:484)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: extra_args is documented as a raw pass-through for 'future CLI flags' (src/claude_agent_sdk/types.py:1876-1881), so a solver can argue the caller owns whatever key and value they put in it, and that it was never covered by the resume/session_id fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: resume has no format constraint in its docs (unlike session_id, which 'Must be a valid UUID'). A fix that rejects non-UUID or dash-leading resume values, instead of binding them with --resume=, can break legitimate resume values. The session-store route deliberately falls through and passes a non-UUID resume to the CLI unchanged.

O6_input_shapes: session_id string with a leading single '-' (fix.diff:107-116)
ordinary UUID / plain id values, kept working (fix.diff:79-94)

O7_producer.where: src/claude_agent_sdk/_internal/session_resume.py:70-87 (apply_materialized_options rewrites options.resume from the store-resolved session id)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: extra_args still emits every flag/value pair as two argv tokens, so an optional-valued CLI flag passed through it (including extra_args={'resume': value}) has the same unbound-value behaviour the fix removed for resume
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: extra_args is a documented raw escape hatch whose keys and values are fully caller-controlled (src/claude_agent_sdk/types.py:1876-1881), so it is easy to argue it is out of scope
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function, about 70 lines below the fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: --model / --fallback-model passed as two tokens; in our copy, make an optional-valued sibling (e.g. a resume-like 'fork from session' string option) emitted the same way
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every string option in _build_command uses the same cmd.extend([flag, value]) idiom, so a new optional-valued option would naturally be written this way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the store-materialized resume id written back into options.resume. A planted variant that takes the id from store/list_sessions data without the UUID filter (session_resume.py:151, :282) would carry a store-controlled value into --resume
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The continue path already resolves the id from store contents (session_resume.py:154-155), so a maintainer could plausibly skip the UUID check on one resolution branch.

O9_family: argument injection (CWE-88): an untrusted option value is parsed as a separate CLI flag of the spawned subprocess

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_transport.py (TestSubprocessCLITransport asserts on _build_command output) and tests/test_session_resume.py; the affected behaviour is a pure argv list, testable without the CLI binary

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate resume as a UUID or reject dash-leading values, instead of emitting --resume=<value> (and forgetting session_id and extra_args)

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix release also hardens build scripts against CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION injection (fix.diff:20); not part of this advisory's source diff.

Other two-token string options (--system-prompt, --permission-prompt-tool, --add-dir, --plugin-dir, --settings, --mcp-config, --thinking-display, --effort) are only exposed if the CLI declares them optional-valued, which cannot be checked from this tree.
unverified: Repo size not measured; tiny_repo is inferred from 24 source files under src/claude_agent_sdk.
Whether the bundled CLI declares any flag other than --resume with an optional value (the fix comment at fix.diff:41-45 names only --resume); this decides whether O8 extends beyond extra_args.
Whether the CLI accepts non-UUID resume values (it affects how strong O5 is).
present_in_latest for the O8 route: no latest release was provided.

pattern_fit is injection_only rather than B: the only O8 route is a single same-function escape hatch with a strong dismissal, in a small library with a single-location fix, a profile the lessons say has never produced a hard task.
